description: An every day bike for your city commuting and transportation needs. A simple design with everything you need to get around smoothly and swiftly. The Vera features Shimano’s new Q’AUTO automatic drivetrain, with automatic electronic shifting so you can keep your mind on what is around you. Inspired by its namesake, the visionary former mayor of Portland, Vera Katz who famously never drove a car. Vera inspired the city of Portland to seek alternative means of transportation and the city has embraced and grown around that Ethos. This Vera will inspire you to do the same.
